title: Notify boss on Telegram
description: After a completed task and explicit review, send its recorded result to the configured boss Telegram chat.

example.note: The proposal package is ready for review.

guidance: The referenced run must have status completed. Configure TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_BOSS_CHAT_ID in server .env. This external message waits for Activity approval. Never report sent without a Telegram provider receipt.
